notes: Across all five rungs, every API surface Claude touched matches @videojs/react@10.0.0-beta.23 and @videojs/html@10.0.0-beta.23 ground truth. Imports (createPlayer, Container, Controls, BufferingIndicator, PlayButton, MuteButton, CaptionsButton, PiPButton, TimeSlider, VolumeSlider, Time, Hotkey, Poster from @videojs/react; HlsVideo from @videojs/react/media/hls-video; VideoSkin/videoFeatures from @videojs/react/video; @videojs/react/video/skin.css) are all real exports. Namespace usage (Controls.Root, TimeSlider.{Root,Track,Buffer,Fill,Thumb}, VolumeSlider.{Root,Track,Fill,Thumb}, Time.Value) matches the parts indices. Props are valid: Hotkey {keys, action} with action values 'togglePaused'/'toggleMuted' present in HotkeyActionName; Time.Value type='current'/'duration' is in TimeType; BufferingIndicator render is a real prop (one-arg use is legal); VideoSkin poster exists on BaseVideoSkinProps; HlsVideo accepts standard video attributes via VideoHTMLAttributes. CSS variables --media-slider-fill, --media-slider-pointer, --media-slider-buffer are declared in SliderCSSVars/TimeSliderCSSVars. Data attributes data-visible, data-paused, data-muted, data-active, data-dragging are all defined in the corresponding *-data-attrs.d.ts files. The CSS class names targeted on the bundled VideoSkin in rungs 3 and 4 (.media-default-skin, .media-slider__fill, .media-slider__thumb, .media-controls, .media-surface, .media-button, .media-button--subtle/--icon/--mute/--captions/--cast/--pip/--play/--playback-rate/--fullscreen, .media-button-group) were sourced from the package's bundled skin.css and confirmed by live DOM queries (the runtime evaluate_script returned non-null elements with the expected computed styles), so they are real classes rather than fabrications. The rung-3 assertion failed because Claude applied the accent as background-color while the harness checks color/fill/stroke/border, which is a test-coverage gap rather than a hallucinated API.
